verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (the AI Helpbot and First Pass AI), so letting its assistant consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents Thoropass acting as an MCP server that outside AI assistants connect to. That is the opposite role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows users can plug their own MCP servers into Thoropass.
